text: {"lessons":["Selling only because a position is above my average cost can make me take gains too quickly; I should decide using future risk and return, not whether I can lock in a win.","Buying A, D, and E again after selling them shows how easily I can let past prices and attachment guide me. Their price histories do not predict what comes next.","A losing purchase is not a reason to hold or add just to avoid admitting a mistake. I should judge each position objectively and keep diversification and the whole account in view."]}
